---
title: "Backend Support Matrix"
---

This matrix records current runtime evidence. `CONVERGING` means the candidate
exists but is not an accepted or stable V1 capability.

| Backend surface | Public namespace | State | Planned order |
|---|---|---|---|
| Palace Electrostatic | `scgsim.palace` | CONVERGING; Route A/B LTlab Slurm + resolve/report exercised | Stabilize after Human acceptance |
| Palace Eigenmode | `scgsim.palace` | CONVERGING; Route A/B LTlab Slurm + resolve/report exercised | Stabilize after Human acceptance |
| Palace Driven | `scgsim.palace` | Planned; not implemented | Later |
| Palace Magnetostatic | `scgsim.palace` | Planned; not implemented | Later |
| HFSS Eigenmode | `scgsim.aedt` | CONVERGING; AEDT 2024.2 run + strict resolve exercised | Current |
| HFSS Driven Modal | `scgsim.aedt` | CONVERGING; AEDT 2024.2 run + strict resolve exercised | Current |
| HFSS Driven Terminal | `scgsim.aedt` | CONVERGING; AEDT 2024.2 run + strict resolve exercised | Current |
| Q3D | `scgsim.aedt` | CONVERGING; AEDT 2024.2 run + strict resolve exercised | Current |
| Q2D | `scgsim.aedt` | CONVERGING; AEDT 2024.2 run + strict resolve exercised | Current |
| Meep | None | Excluded | Not planned |

Backend support requires real implementation, validation, and evidence. A
namespace name or source-lane identity is not support.

See [AEDT Runtime Families](specs/aedt-runtime.qmd) for the current ownership
and failure contract.
